Subject: Post-call recap: Dedicated capacity needs & next steps

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap of what we heard and the proposed next steps so we have alignment:

Pain points / goals
- Production latency spikes during peak appointment booking windows (current p95 ~420ms; target <=100ms)
- Data isolation / HIPAA constraints — dedicated tenancy for PHI; customer-managed KMS required
- Deterministic throughput for business-critical flows (real-time triage, scheduling)
- Predictable unit cost and a plan for auto-scaling during seasonal surges

Proposed Redwood Dedicated configuration (initial ask)
- Reserved: 4x A100-class GPUs in a single dedicated pool (private VPC peering)
- Isolation: Private control plane + customer KMS integration (HSM option if needed)
- Scaling: Autoscale policy to add up to 2x capacity for 2-hour windows, with burst capacity gating by approval
- SLA targets: 99.95% uptime; p95 latency SLO of <=120ms in normal load, with warm-up guidance for cold-starts

Operational notes (from call)
- We will instrument prefix/KV caching for chat assistants to reduce per-token cost and accelerate responses
- Warm-up / preloading plan required for predictable latency at scale — solutions engineer to provide sequence-length guidance

Next steps
1) I'll share a dedicated capacity plan + draft SOW (attached) — Marissa (today EOD)
2) Dylan to confirm caching/warm-up recommendations and exact GPU sizing (tomorrow)
3) Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence — we'll surface our SOC2 report and KMS integration docs (action: Marissa)
4) Align on procurement timeline and PO process — Samir to confirm internal procurement dates

If this looks right, I can send an initial SOW + DocuSign for signatures and loop in our onboarding lead for a kickoff the week of May 3.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Samir — jumping in with a few technical clarifications:

- GPU sizing: 4x A100 is a safe starting point for your current QPS profile, but if your average sequence length is >1k we may recommend a 6x configuration or higher memory instances. We (Dylan) will run a quick sizing check after you share representative token/sequence stats.
- Caching: We'll enable both prefix KV caching and response caching for stateless endpoints; for stateful chat flows we'll recommend a dedicated KV cache with warm-up scripts to pre-populate frequently used prefixes. That will get you closer to the 100ms p95 target.
- Warm-up plan: We can provide a scripted warm-up that runs ~30 minutes before peak windows; for strict latency SLOs we recommend a 15-minute warm-up window to stabilize kernels and KV caches.
- On-call / runbook: Redwood will provide a runbook and add an SRE on-call for the first 30 days post-kickoff.

I'll follow up with a short tech appendix to the SOW that outlines memory, expected throughput, and estimated token cost under the proposed config.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
